description: Our team is full and we are not accepting new members. We are a closed team of [medical students and developers] building a prototype onboard monitoring system for astronauts on deep-space missions. It tracks each astronaut against their own baseline for the headward fluid shift behind spaceflight-associated neuro-ocular syndrome (SANS) and neck-vein stasis. It keeps a running risk estimate, decides when the next measurement is worth taking, and shows its reasoning when Earth cant reply
